title: Initializing
description:
Initialize Supabase once, before `runApp`, with the static `initialize()` method of the `Supabase` class. It restores the persisted session before it returns. Then use the client from `Supabase.instance.client` everywhere in the app.

In Dart projects without Flutter, create a `SupabaseClient` instead. It takes the URL and the key as positional parameters and the same options, plus `functionsOptions`. `realtimeLifecycleOptions` does not exist there, and `authOptions` is an `AuthClientOptions`, which keeps the session in memory unless you set `persistSession` and pass an `asyncStorage`.

The SDK never prints anything. All packages log through [package:logging](https://pub.dev/packages/logging) under the `supabase` logger, so attach a listener to see the logs.

params.name: url
params.description: The URL of your project, found in the dashboard under **Project Settings > API Keys**.

params.name: publishableKey
params.description: The publishable key of your project. A legacy anon key also works here. Never use the secret key in a Flutter app.

subContent.name: authFlowType
subContent.description: Whether to use the `pkce` flow or the `implicit` flow. Defaults to `pkce`.

subContent.name: autoRefreshToken
subContent.description: Whether to refresh the session in the background before it expires. Defaults to `true`.

subContent.name: persistSession
subContent.description: Whether to store the session and restore it when the app starts. Defaults to `true`.

subContent.name: asyncStorage
subContent.description: Where the session and the pkce code verifiers are stored. Defaults to `SharedPreferencesAsync`, or `localStorage` on the web.

subContent.name: storageKey
subContent.description: The key the session is stored under. Defaults to the key the other Supabase client libraries derive from the project URL.

subContent.name: oauthLauncher
subContent.description: Opens the URL of an OAuth, SSO or identity linking flow. Defaults to `UrlLauncherOAuthLauncher`, which opens a browser. The [supabase_flutter_web_auth](https://pub.dev/packages/supabase_flutter_web_auth) package provides a launcher that closes itself when the redirect returns to the app.

subContent.name: detectSessionInUri
subContent.description: Whether to exchange auth callback deep links, such as magic links and OAuth redirects, for a session. Defaults to `true`.

subContent.name: detectSessionInUriPredicate
subContent.description: Decides whether an incoming deep link is an auth callback. By default, a link with an `access_token`, `code` or `error` parameter is.

subContent.name: retryOptions
subContent.description: How a token refresh that never reached the server is retried. Defaults to 8 retries.

subContent.name: schema
subContent.description: The schema `from()` and `rpc` query. Defaults to `public`. Tables used through `table()` carry their own schema.

subContent.name: retryOptions
subContent.description: How GET and HEAD requests that fail with a network error or a retryable status code are retried. Defaults to 3 retries.

subContent.name: requestTimeout
subContent.description: How long a request may go without progress before it is cancelled. Overrides the client wide `requestTimeout`.

subContent.name: logLevel
subContent.description: The level of the realtime server logs to send to the client.

subContent.name: timeout
subContent.description: How long to wait for the server to reply to a message.

subContent.name: heartbeatInterval
subContent.description: The interval at which a heartbeat is sent to the server.

params.name: realtimeLifecycleOptions
params.description: How the realtime connection follows the app lifecycle. By default it disconnects as soon as the app is paused and reconnects, rejoining every channel, when the app is resumed. Use `disconnectAfterPause` to keep it open through short pauses, or `RealtimeLifecycleOptions.manual()` to manage it yourself.

subContent.name: retryOptions
subContent.description: How an upload that failed because of a network interruption is retried. Uploads are not retried by default.

subContent.name: useNewHostname
subContent.description: Whether to send storage requests to the dedicated storage host (`<ref>.storage.supabase.co`). Set to `true` only if your project has it enabled. Defaults to `false`.

subContent.name: requestTimeout
subContent.description: How long a request may go without progress before it is cancelled. Overrides the client wide `requestTimeout`.

params.name: requestTimeout
params.description: How long a request to the database, auth, storage or functions service may go without progress before it is cancelled. The timer restarts whenever data is sent or received.

params.name: accessToken
params.description: Returns the access token of a third-party auth provider to send with every request. When set, `supabase.auth` cannot be used.

params.name: httpClient
params.description: The HTTP client used for every request. By default the client creates its own and closes it when the client is disposed.

examples.name: Print logs
examples.description: Add the [logging](https://pub.dev/packages/logging) package to your app and listen to the records of the `supabase` loggers. `Logger.root.level` defaults to `Level.INFO`.
